aboutPage.title: About AgroBee
aboutPage.intro: AgroBee is an informational digital platform focused on supporting rural development and agribusiness in Albania. It aims to improve access to information, knowledge and development opportunities for farmers and agri-food value chain actors, contributing to a more organized and sustainable sector.
aboutPage.missionBody: AgroBee's mission is to facilitate the digitalization of Albanian agriculture by providing structured information, education and professional guidance for farmers, agro-processors and rural communities, aligned with national priorities and EU rural development policies.
aboutPage.visionBody: Our vision is a more competitive, inclusive Albanian agricultural sector integrated into regional and European markets, where farmers have equal access to information, financing, knowledge and digital technologies.
aboutPage.whatItem1: Information on agricultural markets and B2B/B2C sales models
aboutPage.whatItem2: Guidelines and materials for grants, subsidies and support schemes (e.g. IPARD, national and EU programs)
aboutPage.whatItem3: Educational content on farm management, agrotourism, certifications and sustainable development
aboutPage.whatItem4: Sharing knowledge and best practices from the agricultural and rural sector
aboutPage.whatItem5: Informative links with institutional, financial and professional stakeholders
aboutPage.approachBody1: AgroBee is based on transparency, open access to information and the use of technology to reduce the gap between farmers and the institutional rural development ecosystem.
aboutPage.approachBody2: The platform is designed as a supportive and informative tool that aims to contribute to policies and initiatives for sustainable rural development without replacing the role of public institutions or official programs.

about.title: About AgroBee
